acceptance: PROVISIONAL; numerical RMS pass with median exception and regional evidence limitations; not geographically or user accepted
limitations: Six excluded checks give RMS 84.88 m, within 100 m, but median 89.15 m exceeds the 75 m companion bound. P95 is 105.80 m and maximum 107.21 m. The unchanged first result remains qualified.

All six checks share physical lake systems with controls and are strongly spatially correlated. Northernmost river/parcel band and southeastern/southernmost regions have no accepted independent validation.
Square Lake outer northern extent is generalized; only its distinctive south lobe and central peninsula are sampled. Intervening connected waters are not validated by nearby points.
Natural lake observations use 12 px working source uncertainty. Changed/generalized lake-stream transitions and marsh connections remain unvalidated.
